newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 925 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Wednesday.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 700 head were sold at mostly steady prices for steer calves. "Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA stated.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 76-85 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head they were between 68-75 cents/lb.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 225 head were sold, but not enough to establish trend or quotes prices. The bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
